# Three.js glTF support

Unmodified loader utilities from [Three.js r185](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r185/examples/jsm), matching the site's local Three.js revision 185:

- `loaders/GLTFLoader.js`
- `utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`
- `utils/SkeletonUtils.js`

These modules resolve their `three` imports through Razer's existing import map. They are distributed under the Three.js [MIT license](LICENSE).
